declaration.preface:
NewLife Medicals is committed to fostering a workplace that upholds the dignity, rights, and well-being of all employees. We recognize that our people are our most valuable asset and that a respectful, inclusive, and supportive work environment is essential for sustainable business success. This Employee Rights & Welfare Policy outlines our commitment to fair employment practices, equal opportunity, non-discrimination, and zero tolerance for harassment or exploitation.

We strive to ensure safe working conditions, fair wages, reasonable working hours, and access to grievance mechanisms without fear of retaliation. The Company complies with all applicable labor laws and regulations in the regions where we operate. Through this policy, we aim to promote a culture of trust, transparency, professional growth, and mutual respect across all levels of the organization.
declaration.declaration:
The key objectives of this policy are to:

Ensure fair, lawful, and transparent employment practices for all employees, contract workers, and associates.

Prevent child labor, forced labor, bonded labor, and any form of human trafficking within operations and the supply chain.

Promote equal opportunity, diversity, and non-discrimination in recruitment, employment, and career development.

Provide a safe, healthy, and respectful working environment for all personnel.

Ensure fair wages, reasonable working hours, and statutory benefits in compliance with applicable laws.

Respect employees’ rights to freedom of association and collective bargaining, in accordance with local regulations.
declaration.scope: This Policy applies to all operations of NewLife Medicals., including its offices, warehouses, distribution activities, and global sourcing and supply chain operations. It is applicable to all employees, management, contract workers, business associates, and stakeholders, whether internal or external, working on behalf of the Company.

Employee Safety & Welfare: We aim to maintain a safe, healthy, and hygienic working environment across all locations through robust occupational health and safety management systems.

We aim to address workplace health and safety risks in offices, warehouses, and distribution operations by implementing structured safety procedures, periodic risk assessments, and preventive controls to ensure a safe and healthy working environment.
Promote ergonomic workplace design, proper seating arrangements, safe lifting techniques, and periodic breaks to reduce the risk of RSI and work-related musculoskeletal issues.

We maintain strict compliance with applicable occupational health and safety regulations, including OSHA requirements, and continuously monitor compliance through inspections, audits, and supervisory reviews.
We conduct periodic emergency preparedness drills, including fire response, medical emergencies, and evacuation exercises, to ensure employee readiness.
We promote employee awareness on safety responsibilities through periodic training and internal communication to strengthen a culture of prevention and compliance.
We maintain fire safety systems, emergency response procedures, and first-aid preparedness across operational locations to protect employees, visitors, and stakeholders.

We strive to provide appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) to employees involved in warehouse handling, inspection, or logistics coordination to minimize occupational risks and prevent injuries.
Workplace Standards: We ensure compliance with applicable National federal, state, and local labor laws, including wage and hour regulations, workplace safety laws, and employee welfare requirements.

We aim to maintain a professional, respectful, and compliant workplace environment by implementing clear HR policies, codes of conduct, and ethical business standards to uphold dignity and discipline.
We maintain structured grievance redressal mechanisms to allow employees to raise concerns confidentially and without fear of retaliation to ensure fairness and accountability.
Maintain working hours, overtime, and rest periods in compliance with applicable laws, ensuring employees are not subjected to excessive working hours.
Provide clear appointment letters or employment contracts outlining roles, responsibilities, wages, working conditions, and rights.
We will maintain clean sanitation facilities, adequate lighting, ventilation, drinking water, and rest areas across offices and warehouses.
We strive to continuously improve workplace conditions through employee feedback, internal assessments, and policy enhancements.
We provide comprehensive health insurance coverage to eligible employees to support their medical needs and promote overall well-being.
We provide eligible employees with legally mandated and company-sponsored benefits, supporting physical, mental, and financial well-being.
Learning & Training: We aim to foster a culture of continuous learning by encouraging employees to regularly upgrade their professional and technical skills.

We strive to provide role-specific training programs to enhance operational efficiency in areas such as regulatory compliance, warehouse management, quality control, digital systems, and safety practices.
Our goal is to ensure equal and non-discriminatory access to training and career growth opportunities for all employees across departments and levels.
We plan to conduct periodic performance and development discussions to identify skill gaps and create structured development pathways.
We aim to promote internal career progression by prioritizing merit-based promotions and succession planning wherever feasible.
We strive to strengthen leadership capabilities by identifying high-potential employees and providing them with growth and mentoring opportunities.
We plan to enhance digital competencies across the workforce to improve efficiency, traceability, and data-driven decision-making.
We will conduct regular compliance and industry-related training programs to ensure employees remain updated with regulatory and operational requirements.
We aim to encourage cross-functional learning and knowledge sharing to build organizational resilience and collaboration.
Equal Opportunity & Fair Treatment: We strive to maintain equal opportunity for all employees regardless of gender, religion, caste, age, disability, or other protected characteristics to promote diversity and respect.
We ensure employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, performance, and business needs.
Our goal is to maintain zero tolerance for any form of workplace harassment, including sexual harassment, verbal abuse, bullying, intimidation, or inappropriate conduct.
We aim to eliminate discrimination in recruitment, promotion, compensation, and performance evaluation by implementing merit-based and transparent HR processes to ensure fairness and inclusivity.
We aim to provide regular training and awareness programs on equal opportunity and respectful workplace conduct.
We will conduct periodic reviews to identify and mitigate risks related to workplace misconduct.
We aim to provide mandatory training to all managers and supervisors on non-discrimination, anti-harassment, and respectful workplace practices.
We ensure complaints are handled through confidential, impartial, and effective grievance mechanisms, with protection against retaliation.
We encourage open communication and employee engagement to foster an inclusive and supportive workplace culture.
Diversity, Equality and Inclusion: We aim to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace by implementing structured and unbiased recruitment processes, including standardized interview evaluation formats.
We strive to ensure equitable hiring practices by including at least two interview panel members for managerial roles to reduce individual bias.
Our goal is to promote gender diversity by actively encouraging applications from underrepresented groups in recruitment advertisements.
We plan to conduct annual DEI awareness and sensitization training sessions for all employees, including managers and supervisors.
We will integrate inclusive workplace practices, such as flexible working arrangements where feasible, to support diverse employee needs.
Fair Wage and benefits: We aim to ensure that all employees receive wages that meet or exceed applicable statutory minimum wage requirements in compliance with labor laws.
We strive to ensure timely and accurate payment of salaries and wages, without unlawful deductions or delays.
Our goal is to maintain transparent compensation structures, clearly communicated through appointment letters and employment contracts.
We plan to comply fully with statutory benefits requirements, including provident fund, employee state insurance, gratuity, paid leave, maternity benefits, and other legally mandated entitlements.
We will conduct periodic internal payroll reviews to ensure wage compliance, accuracy, and fairness.

policy.monitoring:
NewLife Medicals maintains transparent reporting mechanisms to monitor compliance with the Employee Rights & Welfare Policy. All labor-related incidents, grievances, health and safety events, discrimination complaints, working-hour deviations, and policy violations are recorded through established internal systems. Periodic reports are reviewed by HR and Compliance teams to analyze trends and identify risks. Serious incidents or material non-compliances are promptly escalated to senior management and, where required, to relevant authorities.

The Company is committed to continuously improving its labor and human rights practices through regular monitoring and corrective actions. Key indicators such as safety performance, grievance resolution, training coverage, employee turnover, absenteeism, and audit findings are periodically reviewed. Internal audits, inspections, surveys, and management reviews help identify gaps and risks. Identified non-conformities are analyzed for root causes, and appropriate corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
policy.reviewMechanism: This Employee Rights & Welfare Policy is reviewed by HR Head annually or as per requirement to ensure it remains effective, relevant, and aligned with applicable legal requirements, international standards, and industry best practices.
